'''2000 North American Continental Championship''' was the Star Wars CCG North American Continental Championship, held at GenCon. The champion received a bye to the semifinal round of the World Championship and travel to DecipherCon 2000.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sc00gc">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/summercons2000/gencon.html Decipher's @ GenCon 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000903035733/http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/summercons2000/gencon.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Yannick Lapointe]] of Laval, Quebec won.<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Continental championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 11–13 August 2000 (GenCon)
* '''Site:''' GenCon, Milwaukee, Wisconsin
* '''Players:''' over 120 on Day 1 (Clayton Atkin's report)<ref name="tr-d6666" />

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 North American Continental Championship Brian Hunter Ralltir done RIGHT aka The Answer (Retirement Party)]] ([[Brian Hunter]], [[Dark]]; Day 2, 3–0)
* [[2000 North American Continental Championship Yannick Lapointe GenCon winner DS deck]] ([[Yannick Lapointe]], [[Dark]]; 1st)
* [[2000 North American Continental Championship Yannick Lapointe GenCon winner LS deck]] ([[Yannick Lapointe]], [[Light]]; 1st)
* [[2000 North American Continental Championship Steven Lewis Monkey TIE's]] ([[Steven Lewis]], [[Dark]]; 2nd) — also on Trandosite as [[Steven Lewis Monkey TIEs]]
* [[2000 North American Continental Championship Steven Lewis Speederholics Anonymous]] ([[Steven Lewis]], [[Light]]; 2nd) — also on Trandosite as [[Steven Lewis Speederholics Anonymous]]
* [[2000 North American Continental Championship Jim Li Stimmed Jim's Scum version 2]] ([[Jim Li]], [[Dark]]; 7–0)
